root_cause: Selfscan lead completion and checkout start were handled on public pages without guaranteed PII-free emission into the canonical growth event/datahub loop.
decision: Bridge high-signal public actions into /api/growth-event while keeping personal contact data out of growth telemetry.
prevention: High-signal public commercial intent must enter the canonical growth loop.
PII must remain in purpose-bound lead/order handlers and never be copied to SEO/growth telemetry.
Website intent augments LinkedIn/e-mail context but never bypasses consent or execution gates.
A public commercial-intent bridge is terminal only after exact-main production identity and browser/readback proof are green.
Skill, Brain learning, human docs, development ledger and System Map must be updated in the same closure lineage.
